name: worker-assignment-app
description: Root orchestration for deployment - installs/builds the client and server as one unit (see README > Deploying it live). Local development still runs client and server separately (see README > Backend/Frontend setup); this file exists for hosting platforms like Render that expect one build/start command at the repo root.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install
scripts.build: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server install && npx --prefix server playwright install --with-deps chromium
